_comment: How the app host routes a request. Read once at server start.
mode: 'crawler'     ONLY per-URL route folders answer: every path is a folder under
ahscripts/routes, resolved by the host's generic file router (literal,
then {param}, then [...rest]). A path with no folder of its own is a 404.
This is the app's mode since tb-0030 step 5 moved every route into a
folder and step 6 deleted the _app/route.ts catch-all.
mode: 'dispatcher'  A single catch-all answers every path that has no route folder of its own.
Kept as a generic capability for an app that wants one; the host's folder
resolution is tried FIRST in both modes, so a folder always wins.
The queue poller resolves /jobs/reconcile through that same generic router, so it needs no
dispatcher in either mode; an app with no folder at that path simply has no poller.
A missing or unreadable file means 'dispatcher' with the default path (backward compatible).
This is MECHANISM: it names no route, no page and no business rule.
